name: VIDEO | Viral reference research -> original production queue | DagnDGKhiNl

parameters.content:
VIDEO VERSION — faithful reconstruction from the source evidence.
Source: https://www.instagram.com/adley/reel/DagnDGKhiNl/
Evidence: [0.08s - 44.71s] [Speaker 0] Had to make a million dollars on social media in six months, how would you do it? Step one, I would find the top 10 most relatable pages in your niche. You're gonna filter that using an app called Sort Feed in your Chrome extension to get the most viral videos. I would aim for anything over 10,000,000 views. Step two, you're gonna take all of those videos, put them into an Excel spreadsheet, and set up your tripod because you're about to get to work. Step three, do 10 videos a day. Step four, you're gonna wanna have something to sell. If you are mega viral, you're gonna want an offer that is cheap. If you're more niche, you wanna go a little bit more expensive. And then step five, you're gonna run retargeting ads to that big, beautiful, warm bucket of people who have been seeing your face over and over and over again because you warm them up. They trust you. They've seen you. And now, you have earned the right to sell them something.
Source-vs-engineering boundary: NEXEN content queue plus source URL provenance, duplicate suppression, per-channel quotas and approval status. Sort Feed stays a manual export because no API contract was shown.
No external side effects are enabled on import.
